description:
## Goal

Surface the existing discovery and import backend endpoints in the UI so users can create brands from scenarios that already have branding elements (colors in CSS, logos, manifest.json, etc.) rather than starting from scratch.

## Current State

### Backend (working):
- `GET /api/v1/discover/{scenario}` — Scans scenario for branding signals from 5 sources:
  1. `.vrooli/service.json` (name, description, tags) — confidence 0.8
  2. `.vrooli/branding.json` (LPBS format: site_name, tagline, theme colors, logos) — confidence 0.9
  3. `manifest.json` (app name, theme_color, icons) — confidence 0.7
  4. Theme CSS files (CSS variables, theme definitions) — confidence 0.6
  5. Static assets (logo.png, favicon.ico, etc.) — confidence 0.5
- Returns: `DiscoveryResult` with sources[], draft_brand, confidence (0-1), suggestions[]
- `POST /api/v1/discover/{scenario}/import` — Creates brand from discovered state

### UI (missing):
- No way to trigger discovery from the UI
- No way to review discovered elements before importing
- No "Import from Scenario" option alongside "New Brand"

## Implementation

### Entry Point
- Add "Import from Scenario" button on BrandListPage alongside "New Brand"
- Could also be accessible from the scenario picker ("This scenario already has branding — import it?")

### Discovery Flow
1. User selects a scenario (reuse scenario picker from brand-manager-scenario-picker)
2. UI calls `GET /api/v1/discover/{scenario}`
3. Show discovery results:
   - Overall confidence score with visual indicator (high/medium/low)
   - Source-by-source breakdown: which files were found, what was extracted, confidence per source
   - Draft brand preview: colors (swatches), typography, identity, assets found
   - Suggestions from the scanner (e.g., "No color system found. Consider defining...")
4. User can:
   - Accept and import (creates brand from discovered state)
   - Edit draft before importing (opens BrandFormPage pre-filled with discovered values)
   - Cancel

### Post-Import
- Brand is created and automatically assigned to the source scenario
- Navigate to BrandDetailPage showing the new brand
- Show what was imported and what's still missing (suggestions)

## Key Files

- Discovery handler: `scenarios/brand-manager/api/handlers/` (DiscoverScenario, ImportDiscovery)
- Brand list page: `scenarios/brand-manager/ui/src/pages/BrandListPage.tsx`
- API client: `scenarios/brand-manager/ui/src/lib/api.ts`
- Domain types: `scenarios/brand-manager/api/domain/types.go` (ScanResult, ScanReport)

title: Build UI for Discovering and Importing Existing Scenario Branding
